ada.text: Good morning, everyone! I started on the green at dawn, then sat on the cottage bench for a while, thinking about my bees. Afterwards I took a lovely swim in the pond to wake myself up. Now I'm here, a little damp and very happy to hear how your mornings went.

bo.text: I was up at dawn and carried my little instrument out to the green, playing softly where nobody could hear. Then I wandered to the orchard and back here. It was quiet, and I liked that.
